# edX Press

> > edX is a global online learning platform connecting 100M+ learners with universities and institutions to advance education and career transformation.

edX Press is the news and announcements hub for edX, the online learning platform founded by Harvard and MIT. The site features company milestones, university partnership announcements, learner success stories, and educational initiatives spanning professional certificates, master's degrees, and open courses.

## Key Topics

- edX platform
- Online learning
- University partnerships
- Master's degrees
- Professional certificates
- Career development
- 2U, Inc.
- Learner network
- COVID-19 response
- Stackable credentials
- Boot camps
- Global education access
- Harvard and MIT
- Workforce development
- Online education innovation

## Company Milestones & Announcements

- [A 100 Million Learner Network. One Shared Purpose.](https://press.edx.org/100-million-learner-network): Milestone announcement: edX reaches 100M learners with career transformation stories
- [News & Announcements | edX](https://press.edx.org): edX news and announcements hub featuring company updates and partner impact stories
- [10 Ways We Brought Our Mission to Life in 2023](https://press.edx.org/10-ways-we-brought-our-mission-to-life-in-2023): edX 2023 year-in-review highlighting mission-driven innovation and impact
- [EdX turns 1: Now what?](https://press.edx.org/edx-turns-1-now-what): edX one-year anniversary reflection on platform growth and future direction
- [We Celebrate Teachers and Healthcare Workers by Reaching Over 100,000 Placements for Our Partners' Students in Online Programs](https://press.edx.org/2u-marks-100k-placements): 2U/edX celebrates 100K job placements in healthcare and education sectors

## University Partnerships & New Programs

- [New University of Oxford Faculty of Law Program Coming to edX](https://press.edx.org/new-university-of-oxford-faculty-of-law-program-coming-to-edx): Oxford Faculty of Law launches governance program on edX platform
- [edX and University of Maryland Launch New Online Product Management Master's Degree](https://press.edx.org/edx-and-university-of-maryland-launch-new-online-product-management-masters-degree): University of Maryland launches online product management master's degree
- [Boston University Opens Applications for New Online Master of Public Health Degree](https://press.edx.org/bu-mph-application-open): Boston University launches online Master of Public Health degree on edX
- [Pepperdine University Joins edX Partner Network with Plans to Launch MOOCs, Stackable Programs on edX](https://press.edx.org/pepperdine-university-joins-edx-partner-network-with-plans-to-launch-moocs-stackable-programs-on-edx): Pepperdine University launches MOOCs and stackable credentials on edX
- [edX and the National eLearning Center of Saudi Arabia Announce Commitment to Extend Access to Learning on edX](https://press.edx.org/edx-and-nelc): edX partners with Saudi Arabia's NELC to expand online education access

## Professional Certificates & Skills Training

- [2U Announces the Launch of edX Boot Camps](https://press.edx.org/edx-boot-camps): 2U launches edX Boot Camps for technical training with 50+ university partners
- [The DEC Institute Joins edX Partner Network with Launch of Professional Certificate Programs in Blockchain and Digital Assets](https://press.edx.org/the-dec-institute-joins-edx-partner-network-with-launch-of-professional-certificate-programs-in-blockchain-and-digital-assets): DEC Institute launches blockchain and digital assets certificates on edX
- [The TEFL Org Joins edX Partner Network with Launch of Professional Certificate Program on Teaching English as a Second Language](https://press.edx.org/the-tefl-org-joins-edx-partner-network-with-launch-of-professional-certificate-program-on-teaching-english-as-a-second-language): TEFL Org launches English teaching certification program on edX platform
- [This summer, you can learn Linux free & online from Harvard & MIT](https://press.edx.org/this-summer-you-can-learn-linux-free-online-from-harvard-mit): Linux Foundation offers free Introduction to Linux course via edX platform

## Learner Success Stories

- [With an Online Master's Degree from Syracuse, This Venezuelan Emigre Is Now Helping to Shape U.S. Immigration Policy](https://press.edx.org/venezuelan-emigre-now-shaping-immigration-policy): Learner story: Venezuelan immigrant transforms career via Syracuse online master's

## COVID-19 Response & Remote Learning

- [edX's COVID-19 Response Demonstrates Momentum as Universities Address Challenge of Upcoming Semester](https://press.edx.org/edxs-covid-19-response-demonstrates-momentum): edX Online Campus enables 400 universities during COVID-19 pandemic response
- [edX Launches Global Initiative to Help Universities Address 'New Normal' of Fully Remote Teaching and Learning](https://press.edx.org/edx-launches-global-initiative-help): edX launches free resources and courses to support COVID-19 remote learning
